instruction: Write an XDP program that performs next-hop routing. Look up the IPv4 destination address. If destination IP is 10.0.38.1, rewrite destination MAC to next-hop gateway and return XDP_TX. Otherwise return XDP_PASS.
requirements: Match IPv4 packets with destination IP 10.0.38.1
Rewrite eth->h_dest and return XDP_TX on match
Pass all other traffic with XDP_PASS
Check boundaries on Ethernet and IPv4 headers

tests.name: test_route_tx
tests.description: IPv4 packet destined for 10.0.38.1 should be routed with XDP_TX

tests.name: test_unrouted_pass
tests.description: IPv4 packet without route should pass with XDP_PASS

tests.name: test_arp_pass
tests.description: Non-IP ARP packet should pass with XDP_PASS

tests.name: test_truncated_pass
tests.description: Truncated Ethernet frame header should pass with XDP_PASS
